capabilities: Render Yandex Tracker issues as tables or Gantt charts in code blocks
Query issues with Yandex Tracker query syntax via yt-issue-query and yt-gantt-query blocks
Display boards, queues, projects, sprints and users as tables
Configure displayed columns with attribute and modifier syntax (ytlink, date, initials, trim)
Authenticate with an OAuth 2.0 token and organization ID
extras: README is in Russian; known issues include overlapping Gantt labels with many tasks and possible API rate limits when syncing across devices; a development plan promises more chart types.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display live Yandex Tracker issue data in notes; users must leave the app or paste static copies.
summary: Integration plugin that renders Yandex Tracker issues, boards, projects, queues, sprints and users as tables and Gantt charts inside notes.
